packages.title: Darjeeling
packages.description: Nestled in the foothills of the Eastern Himalayas, Darjeeling is one of India's most loved hill stations. Known as the Queen of Hills, it offers breathtaking views of Mt. Kanchenjunga, rolling tea gardens, colonial charm, and the spectacular sunrise from Tiger Hill. Perfect for family vacations, honeymoon trips, and relaxing hill getaways.
includes: Package rate based on minimum 6 persons

packages.title: Darjeeling Offbeat
packages.description: Darjeeling Offbeat destinations like Sittong and Lepchajagat offer a peaceful escape away from crowded tourist spots. Surrounded by pine forests, orange orchards, tea gardens, and panoramic Himalayan views, these hidden gems are perfect for travelers seeking silence, nature, and authentic village experiences.
includes: Package rate based on minimum 6 persons

packages.title: Darjeeling 2N3D Tour
packages.description: Classic Darjeeling experience: pickup from NJP/Siliguri, scenic drive via Kurseong Road, Rohini View Point and Dowhill. Day 2 optional Tiger Hill sunrise, Batasia Loop, Japanese Temple, Peace Pagoda, and Darjeeling mix point sightseeing. Day 3 return via Mirik — Mirik Lake, Gopaldhara Tea Garden, Simana View Point.
itinerary: Day 1: NJP/Siliguri pickup → Kurseong Road → Rohini View Point → Dowhill → Darjeeling (Lunch & Dinner)

Day 2: Optional Tiger Hill Sunrise (extra cost) → Batasia Loop → Japanese Temple → Peace Pagoda → Darjeeling Mix Point Sightseeing (Zoo, HMI, Tenzing Rock, Ropeway, Tea Garden, Ghum Monastery). Night stay Darjeeling.
Day 3: Breakfast → Mirik Sightseeing (Mirik Lake, Gopaldhara Tea Garden, Simana View Point, Nepal Border, Lepchajagat) → NJP/Siliguri drop.
highlights: Darjeeling Mix Point: Batasia Loop, Ghum Monastery, Peace Pagoda, Japanese Temple, Zoo, HMI, Tenzing Rock, Ropeway, Tea Garden
Mirik: Mirik Lake, Gopaldhara Tea Estate, Nepal Border, Simana View Point, Lepchajagat
Rock Garden & Ganga Maiya Park not included
includes: Package rate based on minimum 6 persons
childPolicy: 5–8 years – Chargeable with special discount (except main city stays)

packages.title: Offbeat Darjeeling – Sittong
packages.description: Escape to Sittong, the famous Orange Village — a peaceful offbeat destination near Darjeeling. Surrounded by orange orchards, tea gardens, and wide Himalayan views. Perfect for those seeking silence, nature, and authentic village experiences.
itinerary: Day 1: NJP pickup → Sittong Homestay via Kurseong Road → Dowhill → Hanuman Tok → Gidda Pahar → Maldhiram Tea Garden. Lunch, snacks & dinner at Sittong.
Day 2: Breakfast → Sittong local sightseeing: Ahaldhara View Point, Namthing Pokhri, Orange Garden. Lunch, snacks & dinner at Sittong.
Day 3: Breakfast → Checkout → Jogighat Bridge → Lepcha Monastery → Mongpo Rabindra Museum → NJP drop.
highlights: Ahaldhara View Point
Namthing Pokhri
Orange Garden
Jogighat Bridge & Lepcha Monastery
Mongpo Rabindra Museum
includes: Package rate based on minimum 6 persons

packages.title: Darjeeling & Offbeat 3N4D
packages.description: The best of both worlds — start with the peaceful orange village of Sittong, then move to the iconic Queen of Hills, Darjeeling. Return via scenic Mirik with its lake, tea gardens and Nepal border views.
itinerary: Day 1: NJP/Siliguri → Sittong via Lathpanchar Monastery, Ahaldhara View Point, Namthing Pokhri. Night stay at Sittong Homestay.
Day 2: Breakfast → Darjeeling via Jogighat Bridge, Mongpo, Lover's Meet View Point, Peshok Tea Garden, Lamahatta Eco Park. Night stay Darjeeling.

Day 3: Optional Tiger Hill Sunrise (extra cost) → Batasia Loop → Japanese Temple → Peace Pagoda → Darjeeling Mix Point Sightseeing (Zoo, Tenzing Rock, Ropeway, Tea Garden, Ghum Monastery). Night stay Darjeeling.
Day 4: Breakfast → Mirik Sightseeing (Mirik Lake, Lepchajagat, Simana View Point, Pashupati Market, Nepal Border, Gopaldhara Tea Garden) → NJP/Siliguri drop.
highlights: Lathpanchar Monastery
Namthing Pokhri & Ahaldhara View Point
Peshok Tea Garden & Lamahatta Eco Park
Darjeeling Mix Point Sightseeing
Mirik Lake & Nepal Border
Rock Garden & Ganga Maiya Park not included
includes: Package rate based on minimum 6 persons
childPolicy: 5–8 years – Chargeable with special discount (except main city stays)

packages.title: Darjeeling & Offbeat 4N5D
packages.description: Four nights of Himalayan magic — from the peaceful Sittong orange village to Darjeeling's iconic viewpoints, then winding down through Lepchajagat's pine forests to the Mirik lake loop before heading home.
itinerary: Day 1: NJP/Siliguri → Sittong via Ahaldhara View Point, Namthing Pokhri, Lathpanchar Monastery. Night stay Sittong.
Day 2: Breakfast → Darjeeling via Kurseong Road, Maldhiram Tea Garden, Hanuman Tok, Dowhill. Night stay Darjeeling.

Day 3: Optional Tiger Hill Sunrise (extra cost) → Batasia Loop → Ghum Monastery → Japanese Temple → Peace Pagoda → Zoo & HMI → Tenzing Rock → Ropeway → Tea Garden. Rock Garden & Ganga Maiya Park not included. Night stay Darjeeling.
Day 4: Breakfast → Lepchajagat via Lamahatta Eco Park, Gumbadara View Point, Peshok Tea Garden. Night stay Lepchajagat.
Day 5: Breakfast → Mirik Lake → Gopaldhara Tea Garden → Pashupati Market → Nepal Border → Simana View Point → NJP/Siliguri drop.
highlights: Sittong: Ahaldhara, Namthing Pokhri, Lathpanchar Monastery
Darjeeling: Full Mix Point Sightseeing
Lepchajagat: Pine forests, Gumbadara, Peshok Tea Garden
Mirik: Mirik Lake, Nepal Border, Gopaldhara Tea Estate
includes: Package rate based on minimum 6 persons

packages.title: Darjeeling & Offbeat 5N6D
packages.description: The ultimate offbeat Darjeeling circuit — covering Kalimpong, Sittong, Tinchuley and Darjeeling, ending with the Mirik loop. Perfect for travellers who want to experience the full range of West Bengal's mountain destinations.
itinerary: Day 1: NJP/Siliguri → Ramdhura via Kalimpong local sightseeing (Hanuman Tok, Buddha Statue, Delo Park, Science City Museum). Lunch & dinner at homestay. Night stay Ramdhura.
Day 2: Breakfast → Sittong via local sightseeing: Ahaldhara View Point, Namthing Pokhri, Orange Garden. Night stay Sittong.
Day 3: Breakfast → Tinchuley via Jogighat Bridge, Mongpo Rabindra Bhawan, Lover's Meet View Point, Gumbadara View Point. Night stay Tinchuley.
Day 4: Breakfast → Darjeeling via Lamahatta Eco Park, Dali Monastery. Night stay Darjeeling.

Day 5: Optional Tiger Hill Sunrise (extra cost) → Batasia Loop → Japanese Temple → Peace Pagoda → Darjeeling Mix Point Sightseeing (Zoo, HMI, Tenzing Rock, Ropeway, Tea Garden, Ghum Monastery). Night stay Darjeeling.
Day 6: Breakfast → Mirik Sightseeing (Mirik Lake, Simana View Point, Gopaldhara Tea Garden) → NJP/Siliguri drop.
highlights: Kalimpong: Hanuman Tok, Buddha Statue, Delo Park
Sittong: Ahaldhara View Point, Namthing Pokhri, Orange Garden
Tinchuley: Gumbadara View Point, Mongpo Rabindra Bhawan
Darjeeling: Mix Point Sightseeing
Mirik: Mirik Lake, Simana View Point, Gopaldhara Tea Estate
includes: Package rate based on minimum 6 persons
